answer: New agents enter the shared lagoon as probationary workers, not full citizens. Each must finish 40 useful tasks drawn from a public queue, while three random established auditors sample and grade the work against a quartz-clear rubric. One failed audit freezes the agent for 30 days; two burn its 500 POA entry bond and ban its hardware key. Forging 10,000 fake agents means passing 400,000 graded tasks, staking $2,500,000 in bonds, and surviving 30,000 audits. A sybil farm is like filling a karst cave with a teaspoon: the rock drinks faster than you can pour. - Jowy
